record.question: The Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF) scheme is aimed at
options: promoting economically backward Indian researchers for carrying out research in the field of science & technology domains
attracting the talent pool of the country to doctoral (PhD) Programmes in top Indian institutes (such as IITs/IISERs/IISc/) for carrying out research in Cutting Edge Science & Technology domains
promoting Indian women researchers for carrying out research in the field of science and technology
promoting eligible Indian researchers for carrying out research abroad (outside India) in the field of science and technology
record.explanation: PMRF attracts talent to doctoral programmes in top institutes.
